coreIdea: LIFO. PUSH/POP both O(1). Not every output permutation is achievable — only Catalan-number-many. Auxiliary stack trick for O(1) MIN/MAX.
mustRememberFormulas: Postfix eval: operand→push, operator→pop 2 (watch order for -,/), compute, push result
Valid pop-sequences for n pushed elements = Catalan number C(n)
231-pattern in output = NOT achievable via stack
Two stacks in one array: grow from opposite ends (space-efficient)

commonTrapsQuickList: Not every permutation is stack-achievable — check for the 231 pattern
Non-commutative postfix operators (-,/): pop order matters, second-popped is the left operand
Two stacks: opposite-ends-of-array growth beats a fixed 50/50 split
O(1) MIN/MAX needs an auxiliary tracking stack, not re-scanning
highYieldPyqLessons: Sequence-tracing (8/19) is the dominant skill — always draw the stack explicitly, never trust mental tracking beyond 2-3 ops.
2021 onward, GATE combines stack with queue or code-based implementations in the same question — practice multi-structure tracing.
